title: MetricQueryPlan
description: Structured, replayable metric query plan. Raw query languages such as PromQL are intentionally not part of this contract.

metricKind.description: Metric kind used for validation and aggregation compatibility.

matchers.description: Validated backend label matchers. These are not product-level selectors.

rangeVectorSec.description: Range-vector window for rate/increase style operations.

groupBy.description: Backend labels used to keep multiple series distinct.

transform.description: Optional allowlisted transform hint, for example octets_to_bits.

seriesLabelFields.description: Preferred backend labels used to build display series names.
